caseName: Capital Cities Cable, Inc. v. Crisp
caseNameFull: Capital Cities Cable, Inc. v. Crisp, Director, Oklahoma Alcoholic Beverage Control Board

opinions.text: C. A. 10th Cir. Certiorari granted. In addition to the questions presented by the petitioners, the parties are directed to brief and argue the following question: Whether the State’s regulation of liquor advertising, as applied to out-of-state broadcast signals, is valid in light of existing federal regulation of cable broadcasting.
